hooks.logic:
Let part be part 1 of the enemy.
Let part2 be part 2 of the enemy.
If condition flag "do_ability_hosyoku" is up this frame and part2 is dead, then choose state 13 next and stop.
If not the register's 'isDoneColapse' and part2 is dead and not (part2 has the DISABLE status), then
  Part uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{deformTag: "deformation_01"}], [{builtin: "RESET", resetChildNos: [1]}]]} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
  Set the register's 'currBpIdx' to the phase matching the current form of part under the phases list.
  Part changes to form "4".
  Choose state 12 next and stop.
Run helper.
If part2 is ready to act, then
  If increased the register's 'countForBreakSite' is at least the numeric entry "break_site_appearance_disappearance" in the battle settings of the enemy, then choose state 14 next and stop.
  Part2 uses the built-in move DO_NOTHING.
If part is ready to act, then part picks and uses a smart-weighted move.

hooks.logic:
Let part be part 1 of the enemy.
Run helper2.
If part is ready to act, then
  If increased the register's 'countForSinryu' is at least the numeric entry "atb_saved_number_of_times" in the battle settings of the enemy, then
    Part uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{deformTag: "deformation_05"}]]} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
    Part cancels its cast.
    Set the register's 'isDoneColapse' to true.
    Set the register's 'countForSinryu' to 0.
    Part changes to form list at (the register's 'currBpIdx')'s 'paramSuffixNo'.
    Part cancels its cast.
    Choose state 11 next and stop.
  Part uses the built-in move DO_NOTHING.
